title: Branch Sales Manager
description:
**Company:**
Direct Credit

**Location:**
Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Joining:**
Immediate Joiners Preferred

Email: hr@directcredit.in

**Products:**
Home Loan (HL), Loan Against Property (LAP), Working Capital, Personal Loan (PL) & Business Loan (BL)

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Drive branch business, sales, and revenue growth.
* Lead and manage the sales team to achieve targets.
* Develop business through direct sourcing.
* Manage customer relationships and ensure quality loan disbursements.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and lending guidelines.

**Eligibility:**

* 8 years of relevant banking/NBFC experience.
  **(Job stability is mandatory for this profile, frequent job changed can not be considerable)**
* Strong knowledge of lending products and team management.
* Proven sales track record and local market connections.
